public.title: Majority Element
public.description: values contains 1 to 3000 integers from -1000000 to 1000000. One value occurs strictly more than half the array length. Return that value. The majority is guaranteed to exist.
hints: The guaranteed majority survives every cancellation.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Boyer-Moore voting tracks a candidate and cancellation balance. A strict majority remains after pair cancellation. O(n) time and O(1) space.
